# Pico della Mirandola

*1463 – 1494 · Italian · [Renaissance humanism](../movements/renaissance-humanism.md)*

Florentine humanist who sought to reconcile every tradition of wisdom; his Oration on the Dignity of Man makes the human being the creature without a fixed place, who gives itself its own form.
